##### Project general facts

Anantara Residences is a spectacular, exclusive residential property situated within the five-star Anantara The Palm Dubai Resort. Developed by Seven Tides, the project offers studios, spacious one and two-bedroom apartments, and luxurious penthouses available for freehold ownership. Designed with contemporary Asian flair and finished to the highest quality, the residences offer stunning, unobstructed panoramic views over the resort's lagoons, across the iconic Palm Jumeirah, the Arabian Gulf, and the Dubai skyline.

Residents enjoy direct access to the full spectrum of world-class facilities at the adjoining Anantara resort, including a private white-sand beach, expansive temperature-controlled lagoon pools, a state-of-the-art fitness center, tennis courts, and a water sports club. The renowned Anantara Spa offers a sanctuary of relaxation, while multiple signature restaurants and bars, exclusive concierge services, and business and banquet facilities create a seamless resort lifestyle. Every element is designed to elevate daily living into an endless experience of luxury and harmony.

Every residence is finished to the highest quality, featuring high-end materials such as parquet wooden flooring and granite counters. The interiors are meticulously designed to make the most of natural light, with floor-to-ceiling windows in select units. Apartments come fully fitted with luxury furniture and equipped kitchens featuring premium appliances, embodying a sophisticated, contemporary style. The penthouses elevate this further, offering private terraces with swimming pools and expansive living spaces.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on the outer crescent of the iconic Palm Jumeirah, this exceptional location offers a tranquil haven of resort living while providing seamless access to the mainland. Surrounded by lush gardens and crystal-clear lagoons, the property boasts a prime spot on the eastern side of the island, offering breathtaking views of the Burj Al Arab and the Arabian Gulf.

The location is distinguished by its strategic connectivity. Sheikh Zayed Road is easily accessible, placing key destinations like Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach, and Dubai International Airport just a short drive away. This prestigious setting allows residents to enjoy the serenity of island life while remaining perfectly connected to Dubai's world-class business and leisure hubs.

For those seeking a residence that embodies the pinnacle of prestige and the ultimate island lifestyle, Palm Jumeirah delivers an unmatched address. Its unique combination of world-class amenities, iconic landmarks, and strategic connectivity makes it one of the world's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the very best of Dubai — resort living at its finest, sophisticated, and effortlessly connected to the heart of the city.
